source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. both TEMP_MB_PSU1_IN, TEMP_MB_PSU2_IN should get pass result.

original_test_intent: Exercise PSU1_IN and PSU2_IN independently through approved thermal thresholds, verify per-module SEL events and power derating/redundancy/fan/shutdown behavior, then restore both inlets and prove recovery.
original_method: An attended operator changes each PSU inlet temperature or airflow while ipmitool observes sensors; the source omits module mapping, redundancy mode and safe power/thermal envelope.
manual_activity: An engineer maps both PSU modules, establishes safe redundant-power/load state, operates the qualified inlet fixture and owns abort/recovery; automation can correlate each sensor with PSU telemetry and SEL.
required_inputs: PSU bay/module/FRU and stable inlet SDR mapping
thresholds, units, accuracy, tolerance and hysteresis per inlet
qualified inlet-air method, ramp, dwell, maximum, abort and cooldown
load-sharing/redundancy mode and expected derating, fan, failover and shutdown behavior
SEL event mapping, calibrated probes, power telemetry and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not obstruct or heat PSU inlets until redundancy, load headroom and recovery are approved.
Monitor both module temperatures, input/output/load share, fans, redundancy, BMC and host; abort on derating outside plan, redundancy loss, overshoot or instability.
Preserve/hash existing SEL and power logs; do not clear or automatically retry.
Reject DeepSeek's exposed password and disabled host verification.
Restore unobstructed cooling and verified redundancy before continuation.
agent_execution_scope: After setup, poll both inlet SDRs, independent probes, PSU FRU/health/input/output/load, fans, SEL and host state on one timeline.
Attribute each threshold/event and any failover or derating to the correct module and report cross-coupling.
Verify both deassertions, restored load sharing and final PSU/host/BMC health.
Do not operate the fixture, alter thresholds, clear logs, switch power paths or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve PSU identity/topology, power headroom, stimulus and protection/recovery matrix.
Operate the physical setup with emergency-stop authority.
Judge per-module power behavior and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR/sensor lists are baseline-only and cannot prove module mapping, stimulus, SEL, derating, redundancy or recovery; the SSH pattern is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted per-sensor IPMI/SEL plus PSU telemetry synchronized with calibrated probes during engineer-controlled inlet stimulus.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both inlet names, commands, threshold heating, script and 5/10-minute values remain preserved; the approved PSU plan controls timing.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT PSU INLET AND REDUNDANCY PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map and baseline both PSUs, stimulate one qualified inlet path at a time within power headroom, correlate thermal and power-protection behavior, then restore cooling and redundancy.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact PSU FRUs, bays, load-sharing mode and chassis airflow.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU firmware/FRU, BMC/SDR, power policy, fixture and probe versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor PSU inlet/derating/redundancy limits and SEL mapping.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds module identity, power headroom, derating/failover evidence and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One sensor transition or aggregate output cannot establish both PSU paths.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Module map, envelope, event/power matrix and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Thermal derating can remove redundancy or shut down the host.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may use a chamber or qualified inlet fixture, but must record topology, actual method, equivalence limits and coverage for each PSU; redundant operation must not be assumed from PSU count.
expected_evidence: per-inlet specification and approved stimulus/probe plan
timestamped dual-inlet temperature plus PSU load/input/output/health/fan traces
decoded SEL threshold events and any derating/failover/shutdown response
restored cooling/redundancy, dual deassertion, final health, coverage statement and engineer verdict
